subject: Request: interim rebate for SDK rollback affecting OncoHealth launch
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@oncohealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch timing impact — SDK rollback (urgent)

Kimberly / Marcus,

Quick note — we hit a blocker during integration testing: the new SDK runtime change in the 2027.3 package regressed streaming behavior for our long-sequence clinical prompts. The engineering team has pushed a rollback but it cost us two sprint-weeks and will delay feature parity for our oncology triage flow.

This delay puts our launch milestone (May 15) at risk and our procurement team is asking whether Redwood will provide a short-term commercial accommodation while we finish revalidation. Our legal team expects documentation of the timeline and a proposed remediation (credit/discount) to include with the contract amendment.

Attachments: onco_sdk_rollback_timeline.xlsx (timeline), sample logs excerpt attached in Drive.

Can you advise next steps and whether a temporary rebate is possible? We prefer a timeboxed rebate through end of June that aligns with our pilot SLA.

Thanks,
Sarah
VP Product, OncoHealth

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@oncohealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch timing impact — SDK rollback (urgent)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the timeline.

We own SDK rollout and runtime behavior — apologies for the disruption. High level: engineering rolled back 2027.3 and a patch will be staged to the Canary cluster this week. I pushed for an accelerated QA window for OncoHealth, but I also want to be realistic about the commercial ask.

Kimberly — to keep the account healthy and avoid procurement churn, OncoHealth is requesting a temporary commercial accommodation (timeboxed rebate or credits) tied to the period they were blocked. Can we authorize a pilot-level rebate or do we need exec sign-off? I attached a proposed back-of-envelope rebate that maps to estimated token consumption lost during the two-week revalidation.

Proposal (informal): 20% service credit for 6 weeks OR a fixed $30k one-time credit applied to their onboarding invoice. Need guidance on guardrails and approval path.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Solutions Engineering
[Attachment: proposed-rebate-math.csv]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch timing impact — SDK rollback (urgent)

Folks — quick legal & commercial note.

We can do a timeboxed credit; typical constraints: (1) pre-approval for anything > $25k requires commercial leadership sign-off, (2) credits must be capped and explicitly tied to dates and qualifying routes (so we don't create open-ended entitlement), and (3) any deviation from standard onboarding credits needs a one-line amendment in the SOW.

If the team prefers a percent-based credit, document the exact start/end dates and the invoice(s) it applies to. If it's a one-time $30k, that sits at the cusp of approval flow (I can route for signature if Kimberly greenlights). Also note: Escrow/credit language needs to be clear that this is remediation for SDK regression dependent on Redwood root cause and limited to pilot usage.

- Priyom
Head of Commercial Contracts

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@oncohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch timing impact — SDK rollback (urgent)

Team — thanks for the details and the quick triage.

Decision: approve a timeboxed remediation with the following guardrails:
- Offer a 15% service credit for usage billed between 2027-04-01 and 2027-06-30 (inclusive).
- Cap the credit at $28,000.
- Apply the credit to the onboarding invoice and reflect as a one-line SOW addendum stating the credit is remediation for SDK regression during April revalidation.

Marcus, please confirm the billing code to apply and update the SOW text. Priyom, please start the contract amendment flow; we will need a quick e-signature from OncoHealth.

Kim
Kimberly Park
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@oncohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch timing impact — SDK rollback (urgent)

Acknowledged and will action today.

Next steps I will take: 
- Update the SOW addendum with the exact credit wording and cap.
- Instruct billing to create a one-line credit memo tied to onboarding invoice INV-ONC-2027-004.
- Share DocuSign link to OncoHealth for signature and loop in CS to confirm pilot SLA language.

Sarah — we appreciate your patience. I'll share the DocuSign link and the amended SOW by EOD.

Marcus
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Quoted text omitted]
